# Source: Autumn: Harvesting Rice (Aki: inekari no zu), No. 3 from the series "The Four Seasons of Farmers (Shiki no hyakusho)"

This GameCore theme is derived from a **specific, real, public-domain work**—not a generated palette.

## Work

- **Title:** Autumn: Harvesting Rice (Aki: inekari no zu), No. 3 from the series "The Four Seasons of Farmers (Shiki no hyakusho)"
- **Artist / culture:** Torii Kiyomasu II Japanese, 1706 (?)–1763 (?)
- **Date:** c. 1730s
- **Style:** Japanese (culture or style)
- **Classification:** woodblock print
- **Department:** Arts of Asia
- **AIC artwork ID:** 31635
- **Artwork page:** https://www.artic.edu/artworks/31635
- **Public-domain image:** https://www.artic.edu/iiif/2/8f5c9cfd-b43f-fd09-eb38-a281776ace53/full/400,/0/default.jpg
- **Research category:** Autumn and Harvest

## Extracted source palette

`#C8B888, #D8C8A8, #A89868, #E8E8D8, #887858, #A88848, #B89828, #282828`

The image was downsampled deterministically and quantized to a four-bit-per-channel histogram.
Colors were ranked by pixel population and de-duplicated by RGB distance. No random values are used.

## Semantic adaptation

- `background`: `#473E2E`
- `surface`: `#5C5446`
- `on_surface`: `#F8F8F6`
- `primary`: `#B89828`
- `on_primary`: `#0C0C0E`
- `secondary`: `#E8E8D8`
- `surface_variant`: `#5C5446`
- `on_surface_variant`: `#F8F8F6`
- `outline`: `#797266`
- `error`: `#B89828`
- `on_error`: `#0C0C0E`

- Font: `serif` (chosen from source style/classification)
- Corner radius: `6dp` (chosen from source object/design classification)
- Body contrast: background `9.89:1`, surface `7.02:1`
- Variant contrast: `7.02:1`
- Control contrast: `7.04:1`

Backgrounds retain a source hue but are toned toward neutral only when needed to ensure body text is
at least 7.0:1. The primary action remains an extracted source color and its ink is chosen
for at least 4.5:1.
